definitions.explanation: A powerful, deep cry or roar, typically of a large animal such as a lion or beast. Also used figuratively for thunderous sounds or for a person roaring in rage.

examples.japanese: ライオンが{咆哮|ほうこう}した。
{獣|けもの}の{咆哮|ほうこう}が{森|もり}に{響|ひび}いた。
examples.english: The roar of a beast echoed through the forest.

examples.japanese: {怒|いか}りの{咆哮|ほうこう}を{上|あ}げて{敵|てき}に{向|む}かっていった。
examples.english: He let out an angry roar and charged at the enemy.

notes:
A literary and dramatic word frequently seen in fiction, fantasy, and nature documentaries. Also functions as a する verb ({咆哮|ほうこう}する).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{咆哮|ほうこう}を{上|あ}げる — to let out a roar
・{咆哮|ほうこう}が{響|ひび}く — a roar resounds
・{怒|いか}りの{咆哮|ほうこう} — roar of anger

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{雄叫|おたけ}び — war cry, battle cry
・{唸|うな}り — growl, snarl (lower intensity)
